method: NAIVE. Written straight from the deposited text using only the writing-l4-rules skill. No pipeline, no coverage table, no probe record, no independent test pass, no human gate. One pass, no review.

checks.command: l4 run psga-cases-directions.l4 ; l4 run psga-cases-personnel-governance.l4 ; l4 run psga-cases-finance.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: THE WHOLE ACT bar s 1 (short title), s 3 (purposes), ss 43 and 44 (regulations and their presentation) and the CONTENTS of the three Schedules. psga-directions.l4 carries Parts 1 and 2: the public body and its seven Groups, 'Singapore public sector agency', officers and 'relevant public official', control of information, the s 4 power to direct all agencies and its limits, the s 5 power over Group 1 bodies, the s 6 authority to share, the three s 7 offences, the s 8 re-identification offence, and ss 9 to 11. psga-personnel-governance.l4 carries Part 3 (chief executives: appointment, removal, discipline, promotion; deemed public servants and public officers) and Part 4 (conflicts of interest, associates, disclosure, consequences, committees, meetings, written resolutions, delegation). psga-finance.l4 carries Part 5 (estimates, accounts, the auditor and its offence, the auditor's report, reporting to the Minister and to Parliament), s 42 and s 45. Which public body is in which Part of which Schedule is taken as a fact about each body, not enumerated. The three s 7 offences and the s 8 offence are modelled on facts supplied; every judgment (whether information is 'readily observable', whether a belief was reasonable) is a fact supplied. No regulations, order or prescribed circumstances were retrieved, and none of the constitutional Acts of the listed public bodies.
